profile.lead: Your personal settings, devices and access.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: This is how other members see you.
profile.householdHint: These settings apply to all household members.
profile.monthStartHint: Example: start on the 25th → “November” runs from October 25 to November 24. Changes apply from the next month.
profile.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
profile.notificationsLead: Choose per type how you want to be informed.
profile.pushEnabled: Push is active on this device.
profile.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. On iPhone: add the app to the home screen first.
profile.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser. Allow them in the site settings.
profile.pushNotConfigured: Push is not configured on this server.
profile.emailNotConfigured: Email sending is not configured on this server – emails go to the development mailbox.
profile.passkeysLead: Sign in with fingerprint, face recognition or device PIN – no email code needed.
profile.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
profile.apiLead: For your own analyses or automations via the REST API. The token acts like your login – do not share it.
profile.tokenCreated: Token created. Copy it now – it is shown only once.
profile.exportHint: GDPR data access: all data stored about you and your household.
profile.demoHint: Sample data fills all modules for trying things out and can be removed with one click.
profile.deleteText: Your account and personal data are deleted immediately. Household data of other members is kept. If you are the only member, the whole household is deleted.
profile.deleteConfirmText: Type DELETE to confirm. This cannot be undone.
profile.ownerMustTransfer: As owner with other members, transfer the owner role first (under Household).
profile.installHint: BudgetPlaner on your home screen – no app store, works offline.
profile.installIos: iPhone/iPad: tap the share icon → “Add to Home Screen”.
profile.installed: The app is installed on this device.
household.lead: Plan together: members, invitations and household settings.
household.name: Household name
household.monthStartFrom: The new start of month applies from {0}.
household.removeText: {0} loses access to the household. The data is kept.
household.transferText: {0} becomes owner and can manage the household. You become a regular member.
household.inviteLead: By email or as a link – the invitation is valid for 7 days.
household.shareText: Plan our household budget with me in BudgetPlaner:
household.ampelLead: When does the traffic light turn yellow or red? The defaults suit most households.
household.ampel.debtGreen: Debts: payments green up to (% of income)
household.ampel.debtYellow: Debts: payments yellow up to (% of income)
household.ampel.targetsSum: The three targets should add up to 100% (currently {0}).
household.leaveText: You leave the household and start with a new, empty household.
household.deleteText: All household data is deleted for all members. The accounts remain.
household.deleteConfirm: Type the household name to confirm: {0}
household.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these settings.
notifications.lead: Reminders and warnings – in the app, by push and by email.
notifications.inboxEmpty: All caught up. New notices appear here.
history.lead: Who changed what and when? Earlier states can be restored.
history.restoreText: “{0}” is reset to the state before this change.
history.conflictHint: Simultaneous edit – the later state wins; the overwritten value is shown here.
data.lead: Export your data or import items, debts and buffers from Excel and CSV.
data.exportLead: All data for a period – monthly overview, items, debts, buffers and balances.
data.importLead: Upload CSV or Excel, map columns, check and import.
data.fileHint: CSV (separator ; or ,) or Excel (.xlsx), max. 10 MB.
data.personal: Data access and account deletion are in your profile.
err.push.endpoint: This push address is not supported.
admin.lead: Administrators only: server status, registration and all accounts.
admin.noBackups: No backup yet – the first one is created shortly after startup.
admin.smtpOk: SMTP is configured – sign-in codes are sent.
admin.smtpMissing: No SMTP configured – nobody can sign in without email.
admin.pushMissing: No VAPID keys – push is disabled.
admin.mode.open.hint: Anyone with an email address can create an account.
admin.mode.allowlist.hint: New accounts only for listed addresses, email invitations and household invitation links. Existing accounts are not affected.
admin.mode.closed.hint: Nobody except administrators can create a new account. Existing accounts can still sign in.
admin.allowListHint: One per line. “@example.org” approves a whole domain.
admin.blocked: {0} is blocked and has been signed out on all devices.
admin.deleteText: The account {0} and the household “{1}” with all its data will be deleted irreversibly.
admin.deleteTextShared: The account {0} will be deleted irreversibly. The household “{1}” stays available to its other members.
